comments.note: constants.ts now has two independent createRequire-based loaders — the workflow manifest (via workflow-manifest-schema.ts) and the new name mapping — each in separate modules. If additional JSON files are added in future, a shared loader utility in src/utils/ or src/schema/ could reduce duplication. Not worth extracting yet for two files.

The TargetNames and NameMappingEntry interfaces are defined in constants.ts alongside runtime constants. As the type surface grows, consider a dedicated types.ts in src/utils/ for structural interfaces. Current placement is consistent with existing pattern for OrchestratingRole.

summary: WP-004 code review: PASS. The AGENT_NAMES constant implementation is correct, idiomatic, and well-structured.

The createRequire pattern is consistent with the established pattern in workflow-manifest-schema.ts. Relative path '../../../personas/name-mapping.json' resolves correctly from both source and compiled paths (verified by QA and confirmed by TypeScript zero-error compilation).

Interfaces TargetNames and NameMappingEntry are well-documented with JSDoc and the role: AgentRole typing aligns with the manifest-derived enum. The double-cast 'as Record<AgentRole, NameMappingEntry>' is standard practice for well-known schema-constrained JSON sources.
No blocking issues found. No Fix-Forward changes applied. One Documentation-Forward item filed for unit test coverage.

comments.note: [documentation-forward] No dedicated unit test for AGENT_NAMES in tests/utils/constants.test.ts. WP-005 integration tests will indirectly exercise it via cc_agent_name assertions, but a direct unit test verifying all 9 roles are present, that each entry has the correct shape (vscode/claude_code/deep_agents blocks with file_name and agent_name), and that the role field matches AGENT_ROLES would improve coverage isolation. Suggested home: tests/utils/constants.test.ts (new file).

The absence of Zod-based runtime validation for name-mapping.json is deliberate (noted in plan constraints). If the file is malformed, createRequire will throw at module-load time with a clear JSON parse error. This is acceptable for a build artifact whose shape is enforced at generation time. Recommend tracking the deferred Zod schema as a follow-up task.
